label: Clique and star expansions
subgoals: Expand a k-pin net into k(k - 1)/2 clique edges
Expand it instead into k star edges plus one centre vertex
Compare the counts to see which nets dominate memory

label: Weighting clique edges
subgoals: Weight each clique edge by 1/(k - 1) or 2/k
Merge parallel edges between the same pair by adding weights
Sum the contributions of every net containing both cells

label: Choosing a model
subgoals: Eliminate the free star centre to see it equals a weighted clique
Note that no graph model reproduces the hyperedge cut exactly
Use cliques for small nets and stars or Bound2Bound for large ones
